metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Rendered with orrery (github.com/Sagargupta16/orrery): # orrery render docs/diagrams/build.yaml -o docs/diagrams/build -f svg --theme both # Reviewed at README width: orrery review docs/diagrams/build.yaml --width 880 # Checked against the code: orrery verify docs/diagrams/build.yaml title: How it is built and shipped subtitle: One pricing source, a copy of the rates in every tool, checks on every pull request and a weekly alarm direction: right layout: { spacing: compact } legend: dotted: Copied by hand from the sync checklist dashed: Read by a CI check groups: tools: { type: zone, label: What users run } # check-rate-values.py compares six code copies with rate.py: the web tools, the MCP server, the extension, # estimate.py (its tokenizer_overhead too), cost-logger.sh and the retired usage analyzer's table, which # stays until the release that deletes tools/usage-analyzer/analyze.py and is not drawn. The skill carries its rates as prose. copies: { type: box, label: Code copies of the rates, in: tools, evidence: "scripts/check-rate-values.py#RATE_PY" } # ci.yml: the docs-consistency job and the output-trim fixture step run on every pull request; the site, ts-tools # and python-tools jobs also build and test the tools (not drawn). pricing-drift.yml runs weekly and by hand, never on a pull request. ci: { type: zone, label: "CI checks, one of them weekly", icon: logos:github-actions, evidence: [".github/workflows/ci.yml:171#docs-consistency", ".github/workflows/pricing-drift.yml:55#check-live-pricing.py"] } ship: { type: zone, label: How it reaches users } nodes: # docs/pricing-data.md lists every file to update when a rate changes (Sync checklist). pricing: { icon: tabler:file-dollar, label: pricing-data.md, note: "docs/, source of truth", evidence: "docs/pricing-data.md:11#source of truth" } # Both CI checks and the weekly job take rate.py as canonical: its MODELS and _PRICING_VERIFIED_DATE. rate: { icon: logos:python, label: claude-rate, note: "rate.py, canonical", in: copies, evidence: "tools/claude-rate/rate.py#MODELS" } mcp: { icon: logos:model-context-protocol-icon, label: MCP cost server, note: TypeScript over stdio, in: copies, evidence: "tools/mcp-cost-server/src/index.ts:34#PRICING" } # The hook scripts are one node: cost-logger.sh holds the rates, output-trim.sh is replayed by CI, all of them ship from a clone. hooks: { icon: tabler:webhook, label: Hooks, note: "cost-logger.sh has the rates", in: copies, evidence: ["hooks/cost-logger.sh:58#COST_LOGGER_MODEL", "hooks/output_trim.py#updatedToolOutput"] } estimator: { icon: tabler:ruler-measure, label: Token estimator, note: "estimate.py, rates and tokenizer", in: copies, evidence: "tools/token-estimator/estimate.py#MODEL_PRICING" } vscode: { icon: logos:visual-studio-code, label: VS Code extension, note: not on Marketplace, in: copies, evidence: "tools/vscode-extension/src/costEstimator.ts:21#PRICING" } web: { icon: logos:react, label: Web tools, note: site/src/utils/pricing.ts, in: copies, evidence: "site/src/utils/pricing.ts:145#MODELS" } skill: { icon: tabler:puzzle, label: cost-mode skill, note: rates in prose, in: tools, evidence: "skills/cost-mode/SKILL.md:2#cost-mode" } sync: { icon: tabler:calendar-check, label: check-pricing-sync.py, note: every stamp vs rate.py, in: ci, evidence: ".github/workflows/ci.yml:186#check-pricing-sync.py" } links: { icon: tabler:link, label: check-links.py, note: every .md file, in: ci, evidence: ".github/workflows/ci.yml:199#check-links.py" } values: { icon: github:git-compare, label: check-rate-values.py, note: every copy vs rate.py, in: ci, evidence: ".github/workflows/ci.yml:192#check-rate-values.py" } trimcheck: { icon: tabler:flask, label: eval-output-filter.py, note: output-trim vs fixtures, in: ci, evidence: ".github/workflows/ci.yml:154#eval-output-filter.py" } # Fetches Anthropic's pricing page, compares every rate with MODELS and opens or updates one "Live pricing drift" issue. drift: { icon: tabler:alarm, label: check-live-pricing.py, note: "weekly, opens an issue on drift", in: ci, evidence: ".github/workflows/pricing-drift.yml:55#check-live-pricing.py" } page: { icon: logos:anthropic-icon, label: Anthropic pricing page, note: platform.claude.com, evidence: "scripts/check-live-pricing.py#PRICING_URL" } # claude-rate streams from raw.githubusercontent.com; the MCP server, the extension, the estimator and the hooks come from a clone. repo: { icon: github:repo, label: GitHub repo, note: "main branch", in: ship, evidence: ["README.md#raw.githubusercontent.com", "tools/mcp-cost-server/README.md:20#claude mcp add", "tools/vscode-extension/README.md:15#not yet published", "hooks/README.md#Clone or download this repo"] } pages: { icon: si:githubpages, label: GitHub Pages, note: deploy-site.yml, in: ship, evidence: ".github/workflows/deploy-site.yml:46#deploy-pages" } plugin: { icon: logos:claude-icon, label: Claude Code plugin, note: .claude-plugin/, in: ship, evidence: ".claude-plugin/marketplace.json:9#cost-mode" } codex: { icon: logos:codex, label: Codex plugin, note: .agents/plugins/, in: ship, evidence: ".agents/plugins/marketplace.json:11#./plugins/cost-mode" } npx: { icon: logos:npm-icon, label: npx skills add, note: "Cursor, Cline, Codex", in: ship, evidence: "README.md#npx skills add" } edges: - pricing ..> tools: sync checklist - pricing --> sync: stamps, retirements - pricing --> links: links, anchors - copies --> values: compared with rate.py - { from: hooks, to: trimcheck, label: replayed on fixtures, line: dashed, evidence: "scripts/eval-output-filter.py#FIXTURES" } - { from: rate, to: drift, label: MODELS, line: dashed, evidence: "scripts/check-live-pricing.py#_PRICE_ALIASES" } - { from: page, to: drift, label: pricing tables, line: dashed, evidence: "scripts/check-live-pricing.py#PRICING_URL" } - rate -> repo: raw file into python - - mcp -> repo: clone, pnpm build - vscode -> repo: clone, VSIX build - { from: estimator, to: repo, label: "clone, run", evidence: "tools/token-estimator/README.md#python tools/token-estimator/estimate.py" } - { from: hooks, to: repo, label: svg.title: How it is built and shipped
svg.desc: How it is built and shipped. 19 components in 4 groups. Connections: pricing-data.md to What users run (sync checklist); pricing-data.md to check-pricing-sync.py (stamps, retirements); pricing-data.md to check-links.py (links, anchors); Code copies of the rates to check-rate-values.py (compared with rate.py); Hooks to eval-output-filter.py (replayed on fixtures); claude-rate to check-live-pricing.py (MODELS); Anthropic pricing page to check-live-pricing.py (pricing tables); claude-rate to GitHub repo (raw file into python -); MCP cost server to GitHub repo (clone, pnpm build); VS Code extension to GitHub repo (clone, VSIX build); Token estimator to GitHub repo (clone, run); Hooks to GitHub repo (clone, settings.json); Web tools to GitHub Pages (on push to main); cost-mode skill to Claude Code plugin (/plugin install); cost-mode skill to Codex plugin (copy in plugins/); cost-mode skill to npx skills add (reads skills/).

text.tspan: HOW IT IS BUILT AND SHIPPED
One pricing source, a copy of the rates in every tool, checks on every pull request and a weekly alarm
CI CHECKS, ONE OF THEM WEEKLY
COPIED BY HAND FROM THE SYNC CHECKLIST
